  <section v="7">

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The soul even above is like a son drawn from the father's brain, but the essence of the soul rooted in Atzmus is not in the category of drawing and revelation, and through the soul's service in descent it reveals this essence.

translations.translation: The explanation is,
that the soul, even as it is above,
is analogous to a son
(like)
that is drawn from the father's brain,
but the essence of the soul as it is rooted in His essence, may He be blessed,
in the analogy of the son as he is in the father's brain itself
(before being drawn),
is not in the category of drawing and revelation.
And through the service of the soul in its descent below,
to arouse and reveal the nature of ratzo and ascent within it,
which is analogous to the nature of the son's yearning for his father,
through this the essence of the soul is revealed as it is rooted in the Atzmus.
For regarding the level of the soul that is analogous to a son drawn from the father's brain,
the descent to BYA
(and all the more so the descent below in this physical world)
conceals and hides this
[as is known
that only souls of Atzilus are called by the name sons],
and that even in its descent below it is in the aspect of a son in revelation,
that its ratzo and ascent is revealed like a son yearning for his father,
this is through the revelation of the essence of the soul as it is in the father's brain
(before being drawn),
for regarding this level
(the essence of the soul as it is rooted in the Atzmus),
Atzilus and BYA are equal.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Based on this, the connection between the golden Menorah and the word of G-d to Zerubavel is explained, as the Menorah represents the collective souls of Israel and Zerubavel refers to Israel being sown in Babylon.

translations.translation: And based on this, we can explain what is said in Likkutei Torah
on the verse
"I saw and behold a golden Menorah entirely... this is the word of G-d to Zerubavel,"
that the connection of the Menorah to the word of G-d to Zerubavel is,
that the word of G-d is the source of the souls of Israel,
and what is said "the word of G-d to Zerubavel" is,
because Israel then
(at the time of the Babylonian exile)
were called by the name Zerubavel, from "and I will sow them"
for Me in the land
(Zerubavel from the term "sown in Babylon").
And this is the connection of the golden Menorah with the word of G-d to Zerubavel,
for the collective souls of Israel are called a Menorah.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The descent of exile is called sowing because it is for the sake of growth, and the revelation of the essence of the soul through the service in exile is the connection between the Menorah and Zerubavel.

translations.translation: For at first glance it is not understood,
what does the matter of the Menorah have to do with Israel being sown in Babylon.
And the explanation can be said,
based on the known principle
that the descent of exile is called sowing because the intention of the descent is for the sake of ascent,
analogous to sowing in the earth which is for the sake of growth
(in multiplicity,
for does a person sow a se'ah except to bring in many korim).
And this is the connection of the golden Menorah with Zerubavel,
for the matter of "when you raise up the lamps,"
which is the revelation of the essence of the soul
(as above section 2),
is primarily through the service in the time of exile
[for what was stated above, that the revelation of the essence of the soul is through its service in its descent below,
is in general,
and the primary revelation is through the service of Israel in their descent specifically in exile],
and therefore Israel are called here by the name Zerubavel because they were sown in Babylon
(the first exile of the four exiles),
in order to hint,
that not only are Israel a Menorah even in the time of exile
[for even when I am asleep
in exile
my heart is awake],
but moreover,
the descent into exile is a sowing through which growth is achieved in greater multiplicity,
"when you raise up the lamps."
